places.name: Xuan Huong Lake
places.desc: Xuan Huong Lake is the green jewel of central Da Lat, ringed by pine forests and bright flower beds.

places.name: Datanla Falls
places.desc: Datanla Falls cascades through old pine forest with a unique alpine coaster, just 7 km from town.

places.name: Lang Biang Mountain
places.desc: Standing at 2,167 m, Lang Biang is the symbol of Lam Dong, tied to a tragic love legend of a K'Ho couple.

places.name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery
places.desc: Set on Phoenix Hill above Tuyen Lam Lake, Truc Lam is the largest Zen Buddhist monastery in Vietnam.

places.name: Tuyen Lam Lake
places.desc: The 320-hectare Tuyen Lam Lake is a UNESCO biosphere reserve surrounded by ancient pine forest.

places.name: Elephant Falls
places.desc: Elephant Falls plunges 30 m with a thunderous roar through the Lam Ha primeval forest.

places.name: Cau Dat Tea Hill
places.desc: Stretching at 1,500 m elevation, Cau Dat is the source of Vietnam's finest oolong tea.

places.name: Bao Dai Palace
places.desc: Palace III of King Bao Dai — last emperor of the Nguyen dynasty — blends French and Asian styles.

places.name: Pongour Falls
places.desc: Hailed as the 'first waterfall' of southern Vietnam, Pongour spans 100 m across multiple tiers.

places.name: Cu Lan Village
places.desc: Cu Lan Village showcases K'Ho culture — stilt houses and local cuisine deep in Da Lat's pine forest.

places.name: Bidoup–Nui Ba National Park
places.desc: Bidoup–Nui Ba forms the core of the Langbiang Biosphere Reserve, ideal for jungle trekking.

places.name: Dan Kia–Suoi Vang Lake
places.desc: At 1,600 m elevation, Dan Kia is Da Lat's water source, a glassy lake reflecting the pine forest.

news.title: Lam Dong steps up green tourism in 2026
news.excerpt: Lam Dong rolls out new policies to attract visitors to its pine forests, Tuyen Lam Lake and K'Ho villages.

news.title: Da Lat opens new electric shuttle linking central tourist sites
news.excerpt: The new shuttle line takes visitors from Da Lat market past Xuan Huong Lake to Bao Dai Palace, easing inner-city traffic.

news.title: Discover Lang Biang through new VR360 experience
news.excerpt: Travellers can now visit the Lang Biang summit from home with high-resolution 360° photography.

news.title: Cau Dat tea hill — top check-in spot of Q1/2026
news.excerpt: Per the provincial tourism survey, Cau Dat tea hill led visit counts in the first three months of 2026.

events.title: 10th Da Lat Flower Festival – 2026
events.excerpt: From 20–26 December, the 2026 Da Lat Flower Festival gathers hundreds of floral artworks from across the Central Highlands.

events.title: K'Ho Cultural Week in Lac Duong
events.excerpt: An event showcasing gong music, brocade weaving and local cuisine of the K'Ho people at Cu Lan Village.

events.title: Da Lat International Marathon 2026
events.excerpt: Over 5,000 domestic and international runners take on the route around Xuan Huong Lake and the pine forest.

events.title: Music Night: 'Trinh Cong Son – Dreamy Da Lat'
events.excerpt: A tribute concert at Mong Mo Hill featuring renowned Vietnamese artists.
